scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.stack:pgvector: docker compose --profile app --profile local --profile vectors up -d --build
scripts.stack:s3vectors: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.s3vectors.yml --profile app --profile local up -d --build
scripts.stack:up: docker compose --profile app --profile local --profile vectors --profile graph up -d --build
scripts.stack:down: docker compose --profile app --profile local --profile vectors --profile graph down
